requirements.text: Every workflow below is tested against official vendor limits to ensure it remains 100% free forever—no API keys required, no hidden paywalls, and zero technical experience needed.
Tailor Your Resume Offline with a Local Model — Match your existing resume to one job description on your own computer — no account, no upload, and no paid resume-builder subscription.

Make Pro Product Photos From Phone Snaps — 100% Free in Photopea — Turn phone snapshots into studio white-background product shots in your browser — free, no account, no watermark, unlimited exports (limit: browser RAM, ads in UI).

Translate School Letters for Multilingual Families, Self-Hosted — Help parents who read another language understand school letters on a service you run yourself, so family details stay on your own server.

Turn a Textbook Chapter into Flashcards with Local Ollama — Convert a chapter you have already photographed or exported into spaced-repetition cards on your own computer — no study app subscription needed.

Translate Foreign-Language Notices with Self-Hosted LibreTranslate — Run an open-source translation service on your own machine to read signs, notices, and letters abroad, without sending the text to a commercial translator.
